commentary.text: 90+8' The match has just finished.
90+6' Jefferson Lerma (Crystal Palace) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
90+6' Jefferson Lerma (Crystal Palace) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
90+3' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Kevin De Bruyne walks off the pitch to be replaced by Bernardo Silva (Manchester City).
90+2' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. Manchester City have been awarded a corner kick.

90+2' Naouirou Ahamada (Crystal Palace) brilliantly evades multiple challenges and bends in a shot from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal. It's a weak effort, however, and is easily saved by Stefan Ortega.
90+1' Michael Olise (Crystal Palace) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
90+1' Nathaniel Clyne (Crystal Palace) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The ball is out of play. Crystal Palace will have a chance to score from a corner.
90' 7 additional min. will be played.
90' Michael Olise (Crystal Palace) attempts to find Jeffrey Schlupp, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
89' Crystal Palace enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
86' 2 - 4 It's in the back of the net! Jeffrey Schlupp plays it into the box, and Odsonne Edouard (Crystal Palace) gets on the end of the cross to put it inside the right post. 2:4.
83' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
82' Oliver Glasner has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Naouirou Ahamada (Crystal Palace) replacing Will Hughes.
82' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.

81' What a goal-scoring opportunity! Odsonne Edouard (Crystal Palace) finds some space inside the box and gets in a strike, but the shot is brilliantly blocked by one of the defending players sliding in.
79' Matheus Nunes (Manchester City) fires the ball on goal but sends it into orbit. The ball goes out of play and Crystal Palace will have a goal kick.
77' Jack Grealish (Manchester City) is having a lively performance. He is causing problems and wanting the ball at every opportunity.
75' Here comes a substitution. Nathaniel Clyne (Crystal Palace) is brought on as a substitute for Tyrick Mitchell.
74' It is time for a substitution. Odsonne Edouard (Crystal Palace) is on for Jean-Philippe Mateta.
74' We are about to witness a subsitution. Michael Olise (Crystal Palace) for Jordan Ayew.
74' Pep Guardiola prepares a substitution. Julian Alvarez is replaced by Matheus Nunes (Manchester City).
74' Substitution. Rodri makes his way off the pitch and Mateo Kovacic (Manchester City) comes on as his replacement.

70' 1 - 4 Rodri passes to Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City), who collects the ball and unleashes a terrific shot from the edge of the box. His effort goes into the bottom left corner. Fabulous goal! The score is 1:4.
68' Paul Tierney sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
68' The Manchester City players halt their celebrations as referee Paul Tierney makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
66' 1 - 3 It's in the back of the net! Kevin De Bruyne picks out Erling Haaland (Manchester City) with a sweet pass, and he latches on to it deep inside the box and beats the goalkeeper. 1:3.
64' Substitution. Eberechi Eze makes way for Jeffrey Schlupp (Crystal Palace).
63' Yellow card. Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.

60' Wasted effort! Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) received a nice pass in space from Jack Grealish, but his long-range shot was weak and floated well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Crystal Palace will have a goal kick.
59' Erling Haaland receives a sweet cross inside the box from Rodri (Manchester City), but one of the defenders rushes in bravely to intercept the ball.

56' Jack Grealish (Manchester City) latched on to a fine cross from the corner kick on the edge of the box. His shot, however, flies narrowly over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Crystal Palace.
55' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) is about to take a corner kick.
54' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) inside the box. Manchester City win a corner.
53' Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
51' Manchester City exchange some short passes over a small area and control the game. Now they make a mistake and lose the ball and the whole situation changes completely.
47' 1 - 2 Goal! Rico Lewis (Manchester City) picks up the ball inside the box, finds himself in a good position and fires in a shot which is deflected past Dean Henderson. He makes it 1:2.

46' Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) gets inside the box and only has the keeper to beat, but smashes his shot just inches past the left post. He should have scored! The ball goes out of play and Manchester City will have a goal kick.
46' Half-time substitution. Josko Gvardiol (Manchester City) will not participate anymore and Manuel Akanji is coming on.
46' Referee Paul Tierney blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+4' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+2' Josko Gvardiol (Manchester City) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
45+2' Rough tackle by Josko Gvardiol (Manchester City). The referee blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Crystal Palace.
45+1' The corner from Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) is intercepted by Stefan Ortega.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
45' PENALTY APPEAL by Crystal Palace, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!
44' Rodri (Manchester City) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Paul Tierney blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
41' Rodri (Manchester City) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
40' Rico Lewis (Manchester City) fires a strong shot to the middle of the goal and the save is unexpectedly difficult for Dean Henderson.
38' Jordan Ayew (Crystal Palace) gets a shot from the edge of the box, but it crashes against the crossbar! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Manchester City.
38' Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Stefan Ortega, who smothers the ball.
37' Josko Gvardiol (Manchester City) is flagged for offside.

34' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) collects a wonderful lead pass and creates some space to smash the ball goalwards from long range. His shot goes painfully wide of the left post! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Crystal Palace.
34' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
33' Manchester City keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
32' Oscar Bobb (Manchester City) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
31' Rico Lewis (Manchester City) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Jack Grealish.
30' Josko Gvardiol (Manchester City) fires a powerful shot which is blocked.
29' The corner from Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) is cleared away by the defence.
28' The corner kick from Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders. Manchester City earn a corner.
28' Jack Grealish (Manchester City) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. Manchester City will take a corner kick.
28' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
26' Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) commits a foul and Paul Tierney immediately signals a free kick.
25' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 24:76.
24' Jack Grealish (Manchester City) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
23' Looks like Jack Grealish (Manchester City) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
20' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City), but one of the defenders gets it clear.

19' Dean Henderson pulls off a great save to deny Erling Haaland (Manchester City) after receiving a precise defence-splitting pass. The effort is headed for the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper dives superbly to stop it. Definitely the best save of this match so far!
19' Jordan Ayew (Crystal Palace) takes the rebound on the edge of the box and fires the ball just over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Manchester City.
19' Tyrick Mitchell (Crystal Palace) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Stefan Ortega intercepts the ball.
17' The Manchester City players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
13' 1 - 1 Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) blasts the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box and it flies straight into the top right corner of the net!
12' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

11' Chance! Rodri (Manchester City) gets to the rebound on the edge of the box and smashes the ball towards the bottom right corner, but Dean Henderson is alert and makes a great save to deny him. Good work from Manchester City as they win a corner.

10' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety.
10' The Manchester City players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.

7' Great ball in from Kevin De Bruyne. Josko Gvardiol (Manchester City) should really have done better with a close-range header, but he heads it a whisker over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Crystal Palace will have a goal kick.
7' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City).
4' 1 - 0 Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) collects a killer pass inside the box that puts him one-on-one against the goalkeeper. He scores, drilling a low drive deep inside the left post!
2' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.

2' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The linesman makes the right call and Manchester City will have a corner.
2' Paul Tierney blows his whistle and signals a foul after Will Hughes (Crystal Palace) brought his opponent down.
